about: Real-world listening tests in the actual apps, recorded by hand from the tester's own report (pocket/emu/catalog.py turns them into each firmware's `listened` list and its confidence; they never mix with the automated checks). One entry per test: firmware (Pocket id), player (mac or web), engine (fm1-emu or rfm1), build (the firmware file's SHA-256: a test counts for that exact file only), app (app build), machine, who, date, verdict (good, problems, unusable), area (sound, controls, saves) and notes.

tests.notes: Played and controlled correctly; switching engines worked.
Played after switching to the .rfm1 build.
Sounds after PLAY. The keys make no sound, which fits the firmware (a SID tune player).
Sounds when the .rfm1 build is chosen.

No sound from the original package. Investigation: it starts with an empty pattern, so PLAY plays silence until steps are entered; with steps entered it plays through the app's own path (automated). Awaiting a listening retest.

Settings did not come back after relaunching. Investigation: Felucca keeps only user presets saved with SAVE, OCT+, OCT+ (it always starts on its first factory sound); its saves work through the app (automated). Save timing in the emulator integration was also fixed. Awaiting a retest.
A user preset saved with SAVE, OCT+, OCT+ came back after quitting and reopening; the .rfm1 build kept its own.
A user preset saved with SAVE, OCT+, OCT+ came back after quitting and reopening.
A one-tap SAVE came back after relaunching; a G J L chord on the computer keyboard played all three notes; mute was silent at once.
With four steps entered on the keys, PLAY played the beat.
